ex.zh: 他把房子出租给了留学生。
ex.py: Tā bǎ fángzi chūzū gěi le liúxuéshēng.
ex.fa: او خانه‌اش را به دانشجویان خارجی اجاره داده است.
ex.en: He rented his house out to international students.

chg: ex: 一间房子 is an unnatural measure/noun pairing and the Persian did not match; sentence rewritten

ex.py: Míngtiān yǒu rén shàngmén xiū kōngtiáo.
ex.fa: فردا کسی برای تعمیر کولر به خانه می‌آید.
ex.en: Someone is coming to the house tomorrow to fix the air conditioner.

chg: note: removed (the form 上了门 is unnatural and the note adds nothing)

ex.en: I don't have time to eat breakfast now.

chg: ex fa: wrong tense (past 'وقت نکردم' -> present, matching 了 change of situation); fa gloss: more natural 'وقت نکردن'

ex.zh: 这件衣服的价钱太高了。
ex.py: Zhè jiàn yīfu de jiàqián tài gāo le.
ex.en: The price of this garment is too high.

chg: ex: 价钱 collocates with 高, not 贵 (and Persian 'قیمت گران' likewise); py: jiàqián per official pinyin

ex.zh: 爸爸今天外出，晚上才回来。
ex.py: Bàba jīntiān wàichū, wǎnshang cái huílái.
ex.fa: پدر امروز بیرون رفته و تازه شب برمی‌گردد.
ex.en: Dad is out today and won't be back until evening.

chg: ex fa: 才 mistranslated as 'فقط' (only) -> 'تازه شب' (not until evening)

ex.py: Jīntiān de wēndù dīyú shí dù.
ex.fa: دمای امروز کمتر از ده درجه است.
ex.en: Today's temperature is below ten degrees.

chg: fa/en: verb needs infinitive citation form (was a prepositional phrase)
